question: In a mid-term exam of class 11, 42% students failed in Mathematics, 54% students failed in Physics and 48% students failed in Chemistry. Only 10% students failed in all the three subjects. 20% students failed in both Physics and Chemistry, 15% students failed in both Chemistry and Mathematics, and 18% students failed in both Physics and Mathematics. What is the percentage of those students who failed in two subjects only?
